AddUserToOrganizationalUnits.description_en: Adds an EIAM account to one or more EIAM organizations. These organizations serve as subordinate organizations for the account. If the account is already a member of a specified organization, no update is performed
AddUserToOrganizationalUnits.description_zh: 将一个EIAM账户加入到多个EIAM组织中，这些组织作为账户的从属组织，如果账户已属于相关组织，则不做更新

AddUsersToGroup.description_en: Adds multiple Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) accounts to an EIAM group. If the accounts are already added to the specified group, no update is performed
AddUsersToGroup.description_zh: 将多个EIAM账户加入到一个EIAM组中，如果账户已属于相关组，则不做更新

CreateOrganizationalUnit.description_zh: 调用CreateOrganizationalUnit接口，在指定组织下创建新组织资源

CreateUser.description_en: Creates a new EIAM account in a specified organization
CreateUser.description_zh: 调用CreateUser接口在指定组织下，创建新的EIAM的账户资源

DeleteOrganizationalUnit.description_zh: 调用DeleteOrganizationalUnit接口，删除指定组织

DeleteUser.description_en: Deletes an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
DeleteUser.description_zh: 调用DeleteUser接口，删除一个EIAM账户信息

DisableUser.description_en: Disables an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
DisableUser.description_zh: 调用DisableUser接口，禁用指定的EIAM账户

EnableUser.description_en: Enables an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
EnableUser.description_zh: 调用EnableUser接口，启用指定的EIAM账户

FetchOAuthAuthenticationToken.description_en: Retrieves a valid OAuth authentication token
FetchOAuthAuthenticationToken.description_zh: 拉取一个有效的OAuth认证令牌

GenerateJwtAuthenticationToken.description_en: Generates a JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication token

GenerateToken.description_en: Generates an access token for an application in a specified IDaaS instance based on credential information
GenerateToken.description_zh: 使用凭证信息，生成指定IDaaS EIAM实例下某个应用的access token

GenerateTokenByAuthorizationServer.description_en: The token endpoint for an instance-level authorization server
GenerateTokenByAuthorizationServer.description_zh: 实例级授权服务器 Token 端点

GetApplicationProvisioningScope.description_en: The GetApplicationProvisioningScope operation retrieves the synchronization scope of an application in a specific instance
GetApplicationProvisioningScope.description_zh: 调用GetApplicationProvisioningScope接口，获取指定实例下对应应用的同步范围信息

GetGroup.description_en: Retrieves the details of a group
GetGroup.description_zh: 调用GetGroup接口，获取指定组的详细信息

GetOAuthAuthorizationSession.description_en: Queries the current status and authorization result of an OAuth authorization session
GetOAuthAuthorizationSession.description_zh: 查询OAuth授权会话的当前状态及授权结果

GetOrganizationalUnit.description_en: Retrieves the information about an organizational unit
GetOrganizationalUnit.description_zh: 调用GetOrganizationalUnit接口，获取指定组织的详细信息

GetOrganizationalUnitIdByExternalId.description_en: Obtains the ID of an organizational unit based on the external ID
GetOrganizationalUnitIdByExternalId.description_zh: 调用GetOrganizationalUnitIdByExternalId接口，通过组织外部ID获取组织内部ID

GetUser.description_en: Retrieves the details of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
GetUser.description_zh: 调用GetUser接口，查询一个EIAM账户详细信息

GetUserIdByEmail.description_en: Queries the ID of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account by email address
GetUserIdByEmail.description_zh: 调用GetUserIdByEmail接口，通过邮箱获取EIAM对应账户ID

GetUserIdByPhoneNumber.description_en: Queries the ID of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account based on the mobile number
GetUserIdByPhoneNumber.description_zh: 调用GetUserIdByPhoneNumber接口，通过手机号获取EIAM对应账户ID

GetUserIdByUserExternalId.description_en: Queries the ID of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account based on the external ID
GetUserIdByUserExternalId.description_zh: 调用GetUserIdByUserExternalId接口，通过账户外部ID获取EIAM账户ID

GetUserIdByUsername.description_en: Queries the ID of an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account based on the username
GetUserIdByUsername.description_zh: 调用GetUserIdByUsername接口，通过账户名获取EIAM对应账户ID

GetUserInfo.description_en: Retrieves the information about a user by using the user token
GetUserInfo.description_zh: 调用GetUserInfo接口，通过用户token获取账户信息

ListGroups.description_en: Retrieves information about Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) groups by page
ListGroups.description_zh: 调用ListGroups接口，分页查询EIAM组信息

ListGroupsForUser.description_en: Lists the groups that an EIAM user is a member of
ListGroupsForUser.description_zh: 查询一个EIAM账户所属的组列表

ListOrganizationalUnitParentIds.description_en: Retrieves the information about all the parent organizational units of an organizational unit
ListOrganizationalUnitParentIds.description_zh: 调用ListOrganizationalUnitParentIds接口，查询指定组织所有先代节点信息

ListOrganizationalUnits.description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve organization information from EIAM

ListUsers.description_en: Performs a paged query for EIAM account information
ListUsers.description_zh: 调用ListUsers接口，分页查询EIAM账户信息

ListUsersForGroup.description_en: Queries accounts in an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) group
ListUsersForGroup.description_zh: 查询一个EIAM组下的账户列表

ObtainCloudAccountRoleAccessCredential.description_en: Retrieves temporary access credentials for a cloud account role (CloudAccountRole)
ObtainCloudAccountRoleAccessCredential.description_zh: 获取云角色（CloudAccountRole）的临时访问凭证

ObtainCredential.description_en: Queries credential information and retrieves the credential plaintext
ObtainCredential.description_zh: 查询一个凭据信息，获取凭据明文

ObtainJwtAuthenticationTokenByDerivedSho.description_en: Obtain a JWT authentication token using a derived short token
ObtainJwtAuthenticationTokenByDerivedSho.description_zh: 基于派生短令牌查询JWT认证令牌

PatchGroup.description_en: Modifies information about an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) group
PatchGroup.description_zh: 调用PatchGroup接口，更新一个EIAM组信息

PatchOrganizationalUnit.description_zh: 调用PatchOrganizationalUnit接口，更新一个EIAM组织信息

PatchUser.description_en: Modifies an Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) account
PatchUser.description_zh: 调用PatchUser接口，更新一个EIAM账户信息

ReinstateAuthenticationTokenByConsumer.description_en: Reinstate an authentication token for a consumer
ReinstateAuthenticationTokenByConsumer.description_zh: 基于使用者恢复认证令牌

RemoveUserFromOrganizationalUnits.description_en: Removes an EIAM account from one or more EIAM organizational units. The operation succeeds even if the account is not in the specified organizational units
RemoveUserFromOrganizationalUnits.description_zh: 将一个EIAM账户从多个EIAM组织中移除，如果账户已不属于这些组织，则默认成功

RemoveUsersFromGroup.description_en: Removes multiple Employee Identity and Access Management (EIAM) accounts from an EIAM group. If an account does not belong to the group, the removal succeeds by default
RemoveUsersFromGroup.description_zh: 将多个EIAM账户从一个EIAM组中移除，如果账户已不属于组，则默认成功

RevokeAuthenticationTokenByConsumer.description_en: Revokes an authentication token for a consumer
RevokeAuthenticationTokenByConsumer.description_zh: 基于使用者吊销认证令牌

RevokeToken.description_en: Revokes an access token or refresh token

SetUserPrimaryOrganizationalUnit.description_en: Sets the primary organization for an EIAM account. This operation removes the account from the old primary organization and adds it to the new one
SetUserPrimaryOrganizationalUnit.description_zh: 设置一个EIAM账户的所属主组织，账户会从旧主组织移除，并加入到新的组织下

UpdateUserPassword.description_en: Updates the password for a specified EIAM account
UpdateUserPassword.description_zh: 更新指定EIAM账户的密码信息
